instrumentation: No profiler. 20 ms self RSS samples; external 50 ms whole-case process tree samples.
accounting: Self CPU includes RSS sampling and excludes child CPU. Child CPU is a sampled lower bound across setup plus measured work. RSS peaks may miss short spikes. Logical I/O includes cached and pipe traffic; it is not physical disk writes. Windows I/O is process-only; Linux /proc/pid/io also includes waited-for children. Compare I/O within a platform, not between platforms. Data footprint includes live SQLite/WAL state and synthetic seed rows, excludes runtime installation.
